python3 -c '
import subprocess, re, collections

def run(args, **kw):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd="/opt/weather-pipeline/repo", capture_output=True, text=True, **kw)

# 1) unreachable ignoring reflog (all objects that would survive only via reflog or refs)
r1 = run(["git","fsck","--unreachable","--no-reflogs"])
no_reflogs_count = len(r1.stdout.strip().splitlines())

# 2) unreachable even WITH reflog considered = truly dangling right now, prunable immediately
r2 = run(["git","fsck","--unreachable"])
truly_dangling_count = len(r2.stdout.strip().splitlines())

print(f"[A] unreachable ignoring reflog protection (--no-reflogs): {no_reflogs_count}")
print(f"[B] unreachable even considering reflog (truly dangling now): {truly_dangling_count}")
print(f"[C] held ONLY by reflog (A-B): {no_reflogs_count - truly_dangling_count}")

# 3) reflog operation classification over all history (11 days)
reflog = run(["git","reflog","show","--date=iso","--all"]).stdout.strip().splitlines()
print(f"\nTotal reflog entries (--all): {len(reflog)}")

cats = collections.Counter()
per_day = collections.Counter()
date_re = re.compile(r"\{(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})")
for line in reflog:
    if "rebase (start)" in line: cats["rebase(start)"] += 1
    elif "rebase (pick)" in line: cats["rebase(pick)"] += 1
    elif "rebase (finish)" in line: cats["rebase(finish)"] += 1
    elif "rebase" in line: cats["rebase(other)"] += 1
    elif "reset:" in line: cats["reset"] += 1
    elif "checkout:" in line: cats["checkout"] += 1
    elif "commit (amend)" in line: cats["commit(amend)"] += 1
    elif "commit:" in line: cats["commit"] += 1
    elif "pull" in line: cats["pull"] += 1
    elif "clone" in line: cats["clone"] += 1
    else: cats["other"] += 1
    m = date_re.search(line)
    if m:
        per_day[m.group(1)] += 1

print("\nBy category:")
for k, v in cats.most_common():
    print(f"  {k:20s} {v}")

print("\nBy day (all reflog entries):")
for d in sorted(per_day):
    print(f"  {d}: {per_day[d]}")

# rebase(finish) count = number of completed rebases = number of times a
# pre-rebase commit was rewritten into a new commit (orphaning the old one)
print(f"\n[D] Completed rebases (rebase (finish) events) = orphan-by-rebase events: {cats.get('"'"'rebase(finish)'"'"',0)}")
'
